description: Every other site here begins from this starter repository. An index page, two error pages, a catch-all API route, six response security headers, and six tests across unit, integration, and end-to-end suites come preconfigured, along with lint, type checks, GitHub Actions CI, and unused Supabase scaffolding. Error middleware rewrites server errors to a dedicated 500 page, and the layout emits JSON-LD built from a shared route list.
name: Template
